height_offset.criterion: floor band of point cloud visually sits on the z=0 ground grid
height_offset.derivation_note: under R_y(+26) + Z += tz convention, a flat floor maps to Z_w = tz - h; aligning floor to Z_w=0 yields tz = h. Exact for any rotation angle IF the floor is flat.

evidence_class.uncertainty_basis: slider step 0.005m + human eye alignment error at 5m camera distance, estimated
